description: This file defines a class 'ReminderTestGrain' implementing reminder-related functionalities using Orleans grains. It includes methods for adding, removing, and checking reminders, and implements the 'IRemindable' interface.

classes.name: ReminderTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class for testing reminders, implementing 'IRemindable' and custom reminder logic.

methods.name: IsReminderExists
methods.description: Checks if a reminder with the specified name exists.

methods.name: AddReminder
methods.description: Registers a new reminder with a default due and period of one day.

methods.name: RemoveReminder
methods.description: Removes an existing reminder by name, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: ReceiveReminder
methods.description: Handles incoming reminders; currently not supported and throws an exception.
